gse244832.allowed_use: External-development frozen RNA-query cell mapping and donor-by-cell-state RNA-to-ATAC diagnostics only. RNA and ATAC were measured from different aliquots and can be compared only after biologically justified aggregation.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 cells, ATAC, labels, feature statistics, covariate encoding, encoder adaptation, early stopping, or calibration may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only inductive cell-state prediction after selection lock. It has no observed ATAC endpoint and cannot confirm RNA-conditioned ATAC.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA counts only through the frozen direct-query adapter; no labels, eQTL/ieQTL outcomes, query fitting, feature changes, head fitting, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Same-nucleus RNA-ATAC outer-fold training and donor-held retrospective cell/profile evaluation after activation and exact-row-join gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, paired rows, architecture, covariates, parameters, early stopping, heads, or calibration. Held donors supply RNA only to the model; held ATAC remains evaluator-only.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen RNA-to-ATAC encoder representation with cov=None plus identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: frozen direct Bernoulli RNA-to-ATAC peak probabilities; atlas augmentation may use outer-training unimodal cells only and must be named separately

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; never row-paired; donor-by-cell-state comparison only
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only sealed query; ATAC is structurally missing
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact identical ordered row IDs are mandatory for every paired training objective

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nuclei, and peak predictions are not independent biological replicates.
rules.feature_contract: Genes and peaks, including order and any filtering, are fixed inside each outer-training partition.
rules.no_false_pairing: The project adapter must reject a paired object unless donor, sample, nucleus/barcode, row count, and ordered row IDs agree exactly. Upstream merge_paired_data is not sufficient validation.
rules.profile_scale: Score frozen output_px as Bernoulli peak probabilities or apply one prospectively frozen row normalization for a multinomial endpoint. Never derive scaling or calibration from held ATAC.
rules.query_isolation: Prediction receives held RNA tensors and frozen state only. The upstream high-level loader/predict and augment paths are prohibited on held or sealed rows.
